newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha slips $3 with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha slips $3 with crude.

text.p: NWE naphtha slipped about $3 on Friday as the market shuffled into the weekend amid public holidays across parts of Europe.

Gasoline's loss of steam on U.S. futures on Thursday brought screen crude lower, knocking the shine off naphtha. Dealers said the naphtha market was very slow with the trader who for the last few days has been an active buyer at high numbers noticeably quiet.
"He (the trader) had been interested in buying at high prices, but is now out of the market and no one is really offering," said one dealer.
